ValidationRule.description: Related Due Diligence case must be closed before you can move the Opportunity Stage out of due diligence.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(StageName), TEXT(PRIORVALUE(StageName)) = "Due Diligence", NOT(ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Due Diligence")), Due_Diligence_Case__r.IsClosed == false )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please ensure the related Due Diligence Case is closed before moving the opportunity out of Due Diligence Stage
